Company Revenue: Measure: CarYaar revenue recognised in the period (commission and fees, excluding GST) against the approved plan. Source: ERPNext accounts.
Company Profitability: Measure: contribution margin after Service Partner payouts, payment gateway charges and marketing spend, against plan. Source: ERPNext accounts.
Workshop Partners Onboarded: Measure: new Service Partners live in the period (agreement signed, set up in CY Admin, first job completed). Source: CY Admin.
Workshop Partners Managed: Measure: percent of active Service Partners meeting the turnaround and quality standard in the period. Source: WMS and CY Admin.
New Customers Onboarded: Measure: new customers who completed their first paid job in the period. Source: WMS job cards.
Customers Managed: Measure: repeat rate, i.e. percent of customers with a second paid job within 6 months of the first. Source: WMS job cards.
Technology Development: Measure: roadmap items released to production by their committed date. Source: Plane (Development) and release notes.
Technology Maintained: Measure: platform uptime and production incidents resolved within the agreed time. Source: uptime monitor and incident tickets in Plane.
Committed sprint work delivered: Measure: percent of the Plane tasks you committed at the start of each cycle that are Done by its end. Source: Plane (Development).
Production reliability and fix time: Measure: production incidents in your area and the median hours from report to fix live in production. Source: Plane bug tickets and deploy log.
Release quality (defects found after rel: Measure: bugs reported against your releases within 14 days of going live, per release. Source: Plane (bug label).
Support to operations teams: Measure: percent of operations and Service Partner tickets assigned to you resolved within the agreed time. Source: Plane and Helpdesk.
Documentation and knowledge sharing: Measure: runbooks, wiki pages or handover notes written or updated for the work you delivered. Source: ERP Wiki and links in Plane.
Learning plan completed: Measure: items of the agreed learning plan completed and shown to the mentor. Source: learning tasks in Plane.
Assigned tasks delivered: Measure: percent of Plane tasks assigned to you closed by their target date. Source: Plane.
Code review feedback applied: Measure: review comments on your pull requests resolved before merge, with the same issue not repeated. Source: GitHub pull requests.
Team participation: Measure: attendance and contribution in stand-ups, reviews and demos. Source: manager's monthly check-in notes.
Lead to booking conversion: Measure: percent of leads assigned to you that book a service within 7 days. Source: CRM in CY Admin.
Customer follow-ups on time: Measure: percent of scheduled follow-ups and callbacks completed by their due time. Source: CRM tasks and call log.
Customer satisfaction: Measure: average post-service rating, and complaints per 100 jobs you handled. Source: WMS customer feedback.
Job updates to customers on time: Measure: percent of your active jobs where the customer received each status update (estimate, work started, ready) on time. Source: WMS job timeline and WhatsApp log.
CRM data completeness: Measure: percent of your leads and customers with the required fields filled (name, car, location, outcome). Source: CRM in CY Admin.
Service Partners onboarded: Measure: new Service Partners signed and live (first job completed) in the period. Source: CY Admin.
Service Partner turnaround time: Measure: median time from car received to ready for delivery across your Service Partners, against the standard. Source: WMS job cards.
Disputes and escalations resolved: Measure: percent of Service Partner and customer escalations closed within the agreed time. Source: Helpdesk and Plane.
Service Partner quality audits: Measure: scheduled Service Partner audits completed, and the percent that pass. Source: audit records in CY Admin.
Team development: Measure: your team's training plan delivered, and their goals reviewed with them every month. Source: HRMS goals and check-ins.
Partnerships signed: Measure: new partnership agreements signed (fleets, insurers, dealers, corporates). Source: CRM deals and signed agreements.
Revenue from partnerships: Measure: revenue in the period from jobs that came through partners. Source: ERPNext, tagged by partner.
Partner activation: Measure: percent of signed partners that send their first job within 30 days. Source: CRM and WMS.
Partner retention: Measure: percent of active partners still sending jobs after 90 days. Source: WMS job cards.
Pipeline hygiene: Measure: percent of open deals with a next step and date, updated in the last 14 days. Source: CRM.
Content calendar delivered: Measure: percent of planned posts and campaigns published on their scheduled date. Source: content calendar in Plane (Marketing).
Reach and engagement growth: Measure: month-on-month growth in reach and engagement rate across Instagram, Facebook and LinkedIn. Source: platform insights.
Leads from social and ads: Measure: qualified leads attributed to social and paid campaigns. Source: CRM lead source and Google Ads.
Cost per lead: Measure: paid spend divided by qualified leads, per channel, against target. Source: Google Ads, Meta and CRM.
Brand consistency: Measure: published material that follows the CarYaar brand kit (logo, colours, tone) on review. Source: brand review log in Plane (Branding).
Content pieces delivered: Measure: posts, reels and designs delivered by their due date. Source: Plane (Marketing).
Assigned campaigns supported: Measure: percent of campaign tasks assigned to you completed on time. Source: Plane (Marketing).
Monthly books closed on time: Measure: books for the month closed by the agreed working day, with bank reconciliation done. Source: ERPNext.
Payables and receivables on time: Measure: percent of bills paid and dues collected by their due date. Source: ERPNext ageing reports.
GST and TDS compliance: Measure: returns and payments filed by the statutory due dates, with no penalty or interest. Source: GST and TDS filings.
Service Partner payout reconciliation: Measure: Service Partner payouts matched to jobs and settlements, with differences cleared within 7 days. Source: ERPNext and Cashfree settlements.
MIS reports on time: Measure: monthly MIS shared with the founders by the agreed date. Source: ERPNext.
Hiring turnaround: Measure: days from approved opening to offer accepted, against target. Source: HRMS recruitment.
Attendance and payroll accuracy: Measure: payroll run on time with zero corrections, and attendance regularised before payroll. Source: HRMS.
Policy compliance and records: Measure: employee files complete (documents, agreements, handbook acknowledgement) and policies applied the same way for everyone. Source: HRMS.
Appraisal cycle run on time: Measure: goals set, feedback given and reviews completed by the cycle dates. Source: HRMS appraisal cycle.
Employee engagement: Measure: engagement survey score and regretted attrition in the period. Source: survey results and HRMS.
